CUSTOM_USER.description: Login username for the browser session.

PASSWORD.description: Login password for the browser session. Keep it strong — this gates who can use your cloud browser.

TZ.description: Time zone inside the browser session.

CHROME_CLI.description: Extra Chromium flags. --disable-dev-shm-usage is required on Railway (small /dev/shm). Append more flags space-separated.

PORT.description: Port for Railway healthcheck probing. Do not change.

RAILWAY_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: How long the first boot may take before the healthcheck gives up. Small plans start this image slowly, so allow 10 minutes. Do not change.
